title: 2022 Forum Review | The 3D Exploration Journey of Australia's Largest National Brand Kmart
description: Kmart is Australia's largest national department store brand. It operates over 326 stores in Australia and New Zealand, and in the past two years, it has continuously explored new technologies and worked with CLO for digital transformation, comprehensively enhancing the brand's overall competitiveness. CLO has specially invited Emerald, the senior 3D project manager from Kmart's China office, to share Kmart's experiences and insights during its digital transformation journey.

summary: ```markdown # 2022 Forum Review: The 3D Exploration Journey of Australia's Largest National Brand Kmart ## Introduction Hello everyone, thanks for participating in the CLO Virtual User Summit. I am Ying, Business Director at the CLO Shanghai office. I'm so glad to have one of our CLO clients today with us, Ms. Emerald. She joined Kmart in October 2020 as the 3D Manager, running the 3D team and working on Project SQUARE to drive end-to-end digital transformation. Thank you for joining us, and we cannot wait to see your presentation. ## Kmart Australia Overview It's a pleasure to be here sharing some stories about our 3D journey. First of all, let me introduce our brand. Kmart Australia was established in 1969, operating more than 326 stores throughout Australia and New Zealand. This is where our 3D projects originate. ## The 3D Project Squad Our 3D exploration is a bit special. Instead of starting from a functional team, we launched a specialized project squad to drive our digital transformation. Currently, we have 10 team members in the squad, based in three regions, originating from six key functions in the apparel industry. This project started from scratch in October 2020. We made software decisions at the end of June last year after a series of trials and considerations from different aspects. ## Achievements and Benefits Since then, we have completed two seasons of end-to-end developments with the pilot department. We have seen significant benefits from 3D, and the whole company is getting more and more excited about this new way of working. All this success is thanks to the efforts and passion from the whole team and inputs from our stakeholders. ## Insights on 3D Exploration Here, I would like to share something I heard from the Chinese media recently: "There are so many answers in the world waiting for good questions." I found this especially insightful when we talk about 3D exploration. The most important thing is that the world is full of unknowns. In the industry, there are already many good resources, great concepts, amazing technologies, and talented users—all of which support our digital revolution. ## Key Questions and Choices However, at the start, we faced different choices, which formed different paths for the future. It makes a difference if we all start from good questions. Here, I would like to share some important questions and choices we have made, which represent where we are and who we are. ### Question 1: Which Products Shall We Start With? Should we start with easy products or the difficult ones? We must be realistic; we can't start everything at once. It’s better to begin with a small group, create a small success, and then scale up once we have more certainty. From a commercial perspective, life would be less tough if we started with easy styles, such as T-shirts or shirts, which have simple constructions, consistent body shapes, and larger production volumes. However, after overall consideration, we made a bold decision to start with the difficult styles. Our aim was to expose more issues at the early stage, allowing us to prepare better and learn from failures when we could afford to. ### Defining Difficult Styles When defining difficult styles, we considered variations in both styling and fabric. The more variable the fabric, the more handling we had to consider for both draping and appearance. The more diverse the styling, the more construction challenges we faced in the digital world. Ultimately, we chose to start from the women's fashion sector, which represents the most complex case for both variables. ### Overcoming Initial Challenges Initially, this decision almost overwhelmed us. We had to meet the expectations of the development team while managing a heavier workload. We faced various challenges from different styling features day by day and had to train our 3D users in both software handling skills and garment construction knowledge. Additionally, we needed good resources for fabric digitization. I feel incredibly proud of our team for overcoming these challenges, and I must thank CLO for supporting us. Without backing from management, we couldn't have achieved as much. By pushing against boundaries and breaking through limitations, our progress over the past six months has been remarkable. ### Performance Improvements Since making our 3D decision last season, the first sample approval rate in this department broke the record by 7%, and we also achieved significant lead time reductions. With the tricky products under control, we now have fewer product types to worry about in the future. ## Question 2: What's Our Desire for the 3D Operating Model? In other words, how do we plan to use 3D? Do we want to use 3D simulation only in prototyping, or are we prepared for a full digital transformation that changes our development game? Our choice is the latter. We aim to change our working methods based on trust in 3D, rather than treating it as a disconnected part of development. ### Making Prototyping Happen in 3D We need to ensure that prototyping occurs in the 3D world, allowing us to do fitting and rich reviews in a virtual setting. To support this decision, the first step is to make 3D realistic. We must gain the confidence of our stakeholders so they are willing to replace most physical samples in development. #### Key Considerations for 3D Implementation Starting with the fabric, we need to use the correct quality for digitalization and validate fabric to achieve the desired accuracy before applying them to 3D samples. Consistent dress forms are also crucial; we can create a twin set avatar in 3D. The correct 3D pattern is essential, as patterns used for 3D and those for physical sampling may differ. When exporting patterns from 3D for physical sampling, different users might work in different ways. We must ensure that the input and output patterns of 3D communicate effectively by setting up standard 3D pattern criteria and establishing a tracking process. ### Importance of 3D Knowledge We have realized the importance of applying suitable constructions to 3D samples. However, it is important to note that, at this stage, 3D cannot replace all physical samples. It can replace some, but not all. Correlation can provide insights on improvements, fabric accuracy, and potential technical limitations. ## Question 3: What's the Ambition of Our 3D Journey? Is our focus technology-driven or holistic? We unequivocally choose the latter. To win the whole game, we need to implement digital transformation across different aspects and with various parties. ### Role Development and User Skills Good 3D users are fundamental; their skills will determine our success. We need to identify the desired skill sets for 3D users in different scenarios and improve visibility about the skill map of in-house and suppliers to create an effective upscaling plan. ### New Roles in the Industry Consideration of role revolutions is also necessary. There are already established roles in traditional workflows, and new roles may emerge with specialized focuses. For example, I posted a role for a 3D merchandiser, and it took us five months to find a suitable candidate because many people were unfamiliar with the role, questioning its legitimacy. ### Streamlining Development Life Cycle The 3D prototyping process is crucial. When inviting people to join this new game, we must establish a clear agenda and realistic roles to ensure that everyone is enthusiastic about participation. ## Question 4: How Do We Move Forward? Do we move faster alone or further together? While moving faster within a smaller group might seem appealing, it can be risky if we solely rely on our opinions. Therefore, we choose to go further together and embrace small collaborations. ### Collaboration in the Industry In-house team members, suppliers, software companies, and other partners all play key roles in this new world. It is necessary to be open-minded and share resources and information with one another. This way, we can gather input and feedback to adjust our direction in line with industry trends. ## Conclusion None of us can be entirely sure about the future, but by working together, we can create more possibilities. I find these forums to be incredibly valuable, providing great platforms for information sharing. Thank you again for inviting me. I'm looking forward to a brighter future in the digital world with all of you. ```
